# SimplArchive

> An open-source document management system — repositories, index data, full-text search, workflow, retention
> and an append-only audit trail — with a Blazor web client and an Avalonia desktop client. This instance is a
> live demo that resets nightly.

An agent landing here can drive the app itself. The guided tour below is a script, not a recording: it names the
elements to act on, what should be true at each point, and what is worth saying — so you can produce a
walkthrough in your user's language, at their depth, rather than us shipping one video for everybody.

## Guided tour

- [Guided tour (score for an agent)](/tour/tour.md): step-by-step anchors, assertions and narration beats. Read
  the "For the agent reading this" section first — anchors are `data-tour` attributes, and assertions are
  language-independent because the UI is translated.

## API

- [OpenAPI document](/openapi/v1.json): the full HTTP API. It is hypermedia — responses advertise the actions
  available on a resource as named link rels, so follow rels rather than composing URLs from templates. A
  missing rel means "not available to you, here, now".

## Docs

- [User manual (PDF)](/download/manual/SimplArchive-Manual.pdf): generated from the running app.
- [Desktop clients](/download/clients/): Windows, macOS and Linux builds.
